page_title: UNI 1-1 EIN | Union Berlin v Eintracht Frankfurt 06/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+5' A clever short pass gives Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
90+3' Substitution. Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) has come on for Arthur Theate.

90+2' Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) takes the free kick from the edge of the box. His decent attempt goes narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
90+1' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) brings an opponent down and Soren Storks interrupts the game. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Union Berlin.
90+1' The corner is swung in but Union Berlin can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Union Berlin.
89' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Soren Storks had an easy-decision to make.
88' Here comes a substitution. Alex Kral (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Aljoscha Kemlein.
87' 1 - 1 Goal! Kaua Santos gets a hand on the penalty from Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
87' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

86' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) should have been more careful. He commits a bad foul, receives his second yellow card and is sent-off! The referee's verdict is crystal clear. A penalty is awarded to Union Berlin!
84' 0 - 1 Goal! Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper inside the left post. 0:1.
82' A substitution has been made. Mario Gotze is replaced by Mahmoud Dahoud (Eintracht Frankfurt).
82' Albert Riera has decided to substitute Ritsu Doan and he is replaced by Ayoube Amaimouni (Eintracht Frankfurt).
79' Substitution. Andras Schafer will be replaced by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
78' Neat passing move from Eintracht Frankfurt in order to create new attacking opportunities.
76' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) picks up an accurate pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that smashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
73' The free kick from long range, taken by Eintracht Frankfurt, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
73' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) is given a yellow card.
72' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' The referee shows a yellow card to Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
71' The substitution has been made. Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) has replaced Ilyas Ansah.
71' Here is a change. Woo-Yeong Jeong is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin).
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) was quite harsh and Soren Storks didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
67' Substitution. Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Fares Chaibi walks off.
65' It looks like Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) saw red with that tackle. Soren Storks won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
64' Kaua Santos makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) after a cross from the side.
61' Total attempts – 6:2.
59' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.

56' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and shoots towards goal, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
55' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt).
54' Eintracht Frankfurt string together a series of short passes.

52' A rebound falls at the feet of Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
50' Union Berlin control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
48' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) tries his luck but the attempt goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+8' The end of the first half.
45+5' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+3' Ritsu Doan (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Soren Storks blows for a foul.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.

42' Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
41' Union Berlin take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

41' Chance! Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the top of the net, but Kaua Santos is alert and makes a great save to deny him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Union Berlin will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
41' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

39' It looked like the long-range shot by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
37' Union Berlin couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Kaua Santos (Eintracht Frankfurt) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
36' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) has tested the patience of referee Soren Storks and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
34' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
33' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but Kaua Santos comes off his line to gather the ball.
32' Eintracht Frankfurt fail to score from a corner as Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) leaps to collect the ball.

29' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) gets himself into a promising goalscoring position, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
28' A pass by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is behind the touchline and Union Berlin will take a throw-in.
25' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Eintracht Frankfurt) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
23' Eintracht Frankfurt seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
20' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
19' Soren Storks blows for a foul after Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
17' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
11' The game is interrupted.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Eintracht Frankfurt.

9' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Eintracht Frankfurt.
7' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Eintracht Frankfurt.
5' Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
2' The referee blows his whistle after Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Eintracht Frankfurt will have the kick-off.
